rules.notStageable: Impossible as written. The marked line (battleEndTurnOrchestration.ts:1653) returns only when battleOutcome is nonzero after the Leech Seed tick, but nothing in that tick can write it: BattleScript_LeechSeedTurnDrain and its Liquid Ooze tail (data/battle_scripts_1.s:3265-3285) end with tryfaintmon BS_ATTACKER / tryfaintmon BS_TARGET / end2 and have no checkteamslost (unlike BattleScript_DoTurnDmg at :3741-3746, which poison, burn, Nightmare, Curse and Wrap use), and Cmd_tryfaintmon (src/battle_script_commands.c:2965-3045) never writes gBattleOutcome. Cmd_checkteamslost is the only writer (the engine says so at battleScriptFaintedActionsOrchestration.ts:629; the teleport writer is not reachable in the Factory), and the end-turn passes only run while battleOutcome is 0 (battle_main.c:3961). So when Leech Seed drain or Liquid Ooze takes a side's last Pokemon, the battle is decided later, by checkteamslost in the fainted-actions pass (HandleFaintedMonActions, BattleScript_HandleFaintedMon :2831), and the line stays dark. A stage where Leech Seed ends the battle (a seeder against the opponent's last Pokemon) would run other code but never this marker; the line can only be covered by a test that enters the tick with battleOutcome already nonzero, which a real battle does not do.
